title: Municipal Trade License Registration & Silpasathi Portal Compliance in WB
summary: Essential guidance for obtaining and renewing Certificates of Enlistment via the Silpasathi portal and Udyam registration across Baidyabati, Serampore, and Kolkata.
body:
Every commercial establishment operating within West Bengal municipal jurisdictions must hold a valid Certificate of Enlistment under the West Bengal Municipal Act, 1993.

For local assistance with Silpasathi portal applications, visit our [Uttarpara & Konnagar municipal desk](/locations/uttarpara-konnagar) or our [Baidyabati Municipal Chamber Desk](/locations/baidyabati-sheoraphuli).

Executing renewals prior to municipal cutoffs prevents business sealings. Click here to [schedule a consultation](/schedule) with our trade licence team.
